chunks.sanskrit: namo̍ vā̠ce yā co̍di̠tā yā cānu̍ditā̠ tasyai̍ vā̠ce namo̠ namo̍ vā̠ce namo̍ vā̠caspata̍ye̠ nama̠ ṛṣi̍bhyo mantra̠kṛdbhyo̠ mantra̍patibhyo̠ mā māmṛṣa̍yo mantra̠kṛto̍ mantra̠pata̍yaḥ̠ parā̍du̠rmā'hamṛṣī̎n mantra̠kṛto̍ mantra̠patī̠n parā̍dāvm̐vaiśvade̠vīvm̐vāca̍mudyāsagͫ śi̠vāmada̍stā̠m juṣṭā̎m de̠vebhyaḥ̠ śarma̍ me̠ dyauḥ śarma̍ pṛthi̠vī śarma̠ viśva̍mi̠dam jaga̍t|

bhū̠tavm̐va̍diṣye̠ bhuva̍navm̐vadiṣye̠ tejo̍ vadiṣye̠ yaśo̍ vadiṣye̠ tapo̍ vadiṣye̠ brahma̍ vadiṣye sa̠tyavm̐va̍diṣye̠ tasmā̍ a̠hami̠damu̍pa̠stara̍ṇa̠mupa̍stṛṇa upa̠stara̍ṇam me pra̠jāyai̍ paśū̠nām bhū̍yādupa̠stara̍ṇama̠ham pra̠jāyai̍ paśū̠nām bhū̍yāsa̠m prāṇā̍pānau mṛ̠tyormā̍ pāta̠m prāṇā̍pānau̠ mā mā̍ hāsiṣṭa̠m madhu̍ maniṣye̠ madhu̍ janiṣye̠ madhu̍ vakhṣyāmi̠ madhu̍ vadiṣyāmi̠ madhu̍matīm de̠vebhyo̠ vāca̍mudyāsagͫ śuśrū̠ṣeṇyā̎m manu̠ṣye̎bhya̠stam mā̍ de̠vā a̍vantu śo̠bhāyai̍ pi̠taro'nu̍madantu||
brahma̍ me dāḥ khṣa̠tram me̍ dāḥ|
tejo̍ me dhā̠ varco̍ me dhāḥ|
yaśo̍ me dhā̠ stapo̍ me dhāḥ|
viśvā̎bhyo mā nā̠ṣṭrābhyaḥ̍ pāhi sū̠pa̠sadā̍ me bhūyā̠ mā mā̍ higͫsīḥ||
śu̠krante̍ a̠nyad ya̍ja̠tante̍ a̠nyat viṣu̍rūpe̠ aha̍nī̠ dyauri̍vāsi|
sa mā̍ ruci̠to ro̍caya dyu̠tā̠nastvā̍ māru̠to ma̠rudbhi̍ruttara̠to ro̍caya̠tvānu̍ṣṭubhena̠ chanda̍sā|
sagͫ sūrye̍ṇa rocate svāhā̠ sama̠gnistapa̍sā gata|
svāhā̎ tvā̠ sūrya̍sya ra̠śmaye̍ vṛṣṭi̠vana̍ye juhomi|
nettvā̠ vātaḥ̍ ska̠ndayā̎t a̠muṣya̍ tvā prā̠ṇe sā̍dayāmi|
ru̠drāya̍ ru̠draho̎tre̠ svāhā̎ aha̠r jyotiḥ̍ ke̠tunā̍ juṣatām|
apī̍paro mā̠ rātri̍yā̠ ahno̍ mā pāhi e̠ṣā te̍ agne sa̠mit|
indra̍tame̠'gnau pi̠tā no̍'si̠ mā mā̍ higͫsīḥ|
tānta̍ e̠tenāva̍yaje̠ svāhā̎ gharma̠ yā te̍ pṛthi̠vyāgͫ śuk|
ā ca̍ pyāsiṣī̠mahi̍ ranti̠rnāmā̍si di̠vyo ga̍ndha̠rvaḥ|
ma̠hānth sa̠dhasthe̎ dhru̠va āniṣa̍ttaḥ nama̍ste astu̠ mā mā̍ higͫsīḥ||
yadvā̍ ghā sa̠tyamu̠ta yanna vi̠dma dhiyo̍ hinvā̠no dhiya̠ inno̍ avyāt||
su̠mi̠trā na̠ āpa̠ oṣa̍dhayaḥ santu du̠rmi̠trāstasmai̍ bhūyāsuḥ|
pū̠ṣṇe pra̍pa̠tthyā̍ya̠ svāhā̍ pū̠ṣṇe na̠randhi̍ṣāya̠ svāhā̎|
yāste̍ agna ā̠rdrā yona̍yo̠ yāḥ ku̍lā̠yinīḥ̎|
ye te̍ agna̠ inda̍vo̠ yā u̠ nābha̍yaḥ|
sandhā̍tā sa̠ndhim ma̠ghavā̍ puro̠vasuḥ̍ niṣka̍rtā̠ vihru̍ta̠m punaḥ̍||
mā no̍ gharma vyathi̠to vi̍vyatho naḥ|
mā no̍ ru̠dro nir·ṛ̍ti̠rmā no̠ astā̎|
mā dyāvā̍pṛthi̠vī hī̍ḍiṣātām upa̍ no mitrāvaruṇāvi̠hāva̍tam|
u̠grā śa̠tāpā̎ṣṭhā gha̠ viṣā̠ pari̍ṇo vṛṇaktu||
yadi̍ dakhṣiṇa̠to vadā̎d dvi̠ṣanta̠m me'va̍ bādhāsai
nṛ̠mṇāyi nṛ̠mṇam nṛ̠mṇāyi nṛ̠mṇam nṛ̠mṇāyi nṛ̠mṇam|
ni̠dhā yyo̍'vāyi ni̠dhā yyo̍'vāyi ni̠dhā yyo̍'vāyi|
agne̎ vratapate vra̠tañca̍riṣyāmi taccha̍keyaṃ̠ tanme̍ rāddhyatām|
śanno̠ vātaḥ̍ pavatām māta̠riśvā̠ śanna̍stapatu̠ sūryaḥ̍|
ahā̍ni̠ śam bha̍vantu naḥ̠ śagͫ rātriḥ̠ prati̍dhīyatām||
śamu̠ṣā no̠ vyu̍cchatu̠ śamā̍di̠tya ude̍tu naḥ|
śi̠vā naḥ̠ śanta̍mā bhava sumṛḍī̠kā sara̍svati|
iḍā̍yai̠ vāstva̍si vāstu̠mad vā̎stu̠manto̍ bhūyāsma̠ mā vāsto̎śchithsmahya vā̠stuḥ sa bhū̍yā̠dyo̎'smān dveṣṭi̠ yañca̍ va̠yaṃ dvi̠ṣmaḥ||
pra̠ti̠ṣṭhā'si̍ prati̠ṣṭhāva̍nto bhūyāsma̠ mā pra̍ti̠ṣṭhāyā̎ śchithsmahya prati̠ṣṭhaḥ sa bhū̍yā̠d yo̎'smān dveṣṭi̠ yañca̍ va̠yaṃ dvi̠ṣmaḥ||
ā vā̍ta vāhi bheṣa̠javm̐vi vā̍ta vāhi̠ yadrapaḥ̍|
tvagͫ hi vi̠śvabhe̍ṣajo de̠vānāṃ̎ dū̠ta īya̍se||
dvāvi̠mau vātau̍ vāta̠ ā sindhā̠rā pa̍rā̠vataḥ̍ dakhṣa̍m me a̠nya ā̠vātu̠ parā̠'nyo vā̍tu̠ yadrapaḥ̍||
tato̍ no dehi jī̠vase̠ tato̍ no dhehi bheṣa̠jam||
tato̍ no̠ maha̠ āva̍ha̠ vāta̠ āvā̍tu bheṣa̠jam|
śa̠mbhūr ma̍yo̠bhūrno̍ hṛ̠de pra ṇa̠ āyū̍gͫṣi tāriṣat||
indra̍sya gṛ̠ho̍'si̠ tam tvā̠ prapa̍dye̠ sagu̠ssāśvaḥ̍|

bhūḥ prapa̍dye̠ bhuvaḥ̠ prapa̍dye̠ suvaḥ̠ prapa̍dye̠ bhūrbhuva̠ssuvaḥ̠ prapa̍dye vā̠yum prapa̠dye'nā̎rtām de̠vatā̠m prapa̠dye 'śmā̍namākha̠ṇam prapa̍dye pra̠jāpa̍ter brahmako̠śam brahma̠ prapa̍dya̠ om prapa̍dye||
a̠ntari̍khṣam ma u̠rva̍ntara̍m bṛ̠hada̠gnayaḥ̠ parva̍tāśca̠ yayā̠ vātaḥ̍ sva̠styā sva̍sti̠māntayā̎ sva̠styā sva̍sti̠ māna̍sāni||

prāṇā̍pānau mṛ̠tyormā̍ pāta̠m prāṇā̍pānau̠ mā mā̍ hāsiṣṭa̠m mayi̍ me̠dhām mayi̍ pra̠jām mayya̠gni stejo̍ dadhātu̠ mayi̍ me̠dhām mayi̍ pra̠jām mayīndra̍ indri̠yam da̍dhātu̠ mayi̍ me̠dhām mayi̍ pra̠jām mayi̠ sūryo̠ bhrājo̍ dadhātu dyu̠bhira̠ktubhiḥ̠ pari̍pātama̠smānari̍ṣṭebhiraśvinā̠ saubha̍gebhiḥ|
tanno̍ mi̠tro varu̍ṇo māmahantā̠ madi̍tiḥ̠ sindhuḥ̍ pṛthi̠vī u̠ta dyauḥ||
vayaḥ̍ supa̠rṇā upa̍sedu̠rindra̍m pri̠yame̍dhā̠ ṛṣa̍yo̠ nādha̍mānāḥ|
apa̍ dhvā̠ntamū̎rṇu̠hi pū̠rddhi cakhṣu̍r mumu̠gdhya̍smānni̠dhaye̍va ba̠ddhān śanno̍ de̠vīra̠bhiṣṭa̍ya̠ āpo̍ bhavantu pī̠taye̎|
su̠mi̠trā na̠ āpa̠ oṣa̍dhayaḥ santu durmi̠trāstasmai̍ bhūyāsu̠ryo̎'smāndveṣṭi̠ yañca̍ va̠yaṃ dvi̠ṣmaḥ||
āpo̠ hi ṣṭhā ma̍yo̠bhuva̠stā na̍ ū̠rje da̍dhātana|
yo vaḥ̍ śi̠vata̍mo̠ rasa̠stasya̍ bhājayate̠ha naḥ̍|
tasmā̠ ara̍m gamāma vo̠ yasya̠ khṣayā̍ya̠ jinva̍tha āpo̍ ja̠naya̍thā ca naḥ||
pṛ̠thi̠vī śā̠ntā sā'gninā̍ śā̠ntā sā me̍ śā̠ntā śuca̍gͫ śamayatu||
a̠ntari̍khṣagͫ śā̠ntaṃ tad vā̠yunā̍ śā̠ntaṃ tanme̍ śā̠ntagͫ śuca̍gͫ śamayatu|
dyauḥ śā̠ntā sā''di̠tyena̍ śā̠ntā sā me̍ śā̠ntā śuca̍gͫ śamayatu||

pṛ̠thi̠vī śānti̍ra̠ntari̍khṣa̠g̠ͫ śānti̠r dyauḥ śānti̠r diśaḥ̠ śānti̍ ravāntaradi̠śāḥ śānti̍ ra̠gniḥ śānti̍r vā̠yuḥ śānti̍ rādi̠tyaḥ śānti̍ śca̠ndramāḥ̠ śānti̠r nakhṣa̍trāṇi̠ śānti̠ rāpaḥ̠ śānti̠ roṣa̍dhayaḥ̠ śānti̠r vana̠spata̍yaḥ̠ śānti̠r gauḥ śānti̍ ra̠jā śānti̠ raśvaḥ̠ śāntiḥ̠ puru̍ṣaḥ̠ śānti̠r brahma̠ śānti̍r brāhma̠ṇaḥ śāntiḥ̠ śānti̍re̠va śāntiḥ̠ śānti̍rme astu̠ śāntiḥ̍||
tayā̠'hagͫ śā̠ntyā sa̍rvaśā̠ntyā mahyaṃ̍ dvi̠pade̠ catu̍ṣpade ca̠ śānti̍m karomi̠ śānti̍rme astu̠ śāntiḥ̍||

eha̠ śrīśca̠ hrīśca̠ dhṛti̍śca̠ tapo̍ me̠dhā pra̍ti̠ṣṭhā śra̠ddhā sa̠tyaṃ dharma̍ścai̠tāni̠ motti̍ṣṭhanta̠manūtti̍ṣṭhantu̠ mā mā̠g̠ͫͫ śrīśca̠ hrīśca̠ dhṛti̍śca̠ tapo̍ me̠dhā pra̍ti̠ṣṭhā śra̠ddhā sa̠tyaṃ dharma̍ścai̠tāni̍ mā̠ mā hā̍siṣuḥ||
udāyu̍ṣā svā̠yuṣodoṣa̍dhīnā̠g̠ͫ rase̠not pa̠rjanya̍sya̠ śuṣme̠ṇoda̍sthāma̠mṛtā̠g̠ͫ anu̍||

paśye̍ma śa̠radaḥ̍ śa̠tam jīve̍ma śa̠radaḥ̍ śa̠tam nandā̍ma śa̠radaḥ̍ śa̠tam modā̍ma śa̠radaḥ̍ śa̠tam bhavā̍ma śa̠radaḥ̍ śa̠tagͫ śṛ̠ṇavā̍ma śa̠radaḥ̍ śa̠tam prabra̍vāma śa̠radaḥ̍ śa̠ta majī̍tāḥ syāma śa̠radaḥ̍ śa̠tam jyokca̠ sūrya̍m dṛ̠śe ya uda̍gān maha̠to'rṇavā̎dvi̠bhrāja̍mānaḥ sari̠rasya̠ maddhyā̠thsa mā̍ vṛṣa̠bho lo̍hitā̠khṣaḥ sūryo̍ vipa̠ścin mana̍sā punātu||

brahma̍ṇaḥ̠ ścota̍nyasi̠ brahma̍ṇa ā̠ṇī stho̠ brahma̍ṇa ā̠vapa̍namasi dhāri̠teyam pṛ̍thi̠vī brahma̍ṇā ma̠hī dhā̍ri̠tame̍nena ma̠hada̠ntari̍khṣa̠m diva̍m dādhāra pṛthi̠vīgͫ sade̍vā̠ym̐yada̠havm̐veda̠ tada̠haṃ dhā̍rayāṇi̠ mā madvedo'dhi̠ visra̍sat||
me̠dhā̠ma̠nī̠ṣe mā''vi̍śatāgͫ sa̠mīcī̍ bhū̠tasya̠ bhavya̠syāva̍ruddhyai̠ sarva̠māyu̍rayāṇi̠ sarva̠māyu̍rayāṇi||
ā̠bhir gī̠rbhir yadato̍ na ū̠namāpyā̍yaya harivo̠ vadrdha̍mānaḥ|
ya̠dā sto̠tṛbhyo̠ mahi̍ go̠trā ru̠jāsi̍ bhūyiṣṭha̠bhājo̠ adha̍ te syāma||
